                    curst.append(n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1));

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; lastdig++) {

                        variables.add(count_with_prefix(tmp + '0', n, n_str) % mod);
                        tmp += '0';

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx < variables.size(); t_idx++) {
                        long val = variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - t_idx) - pw10[t_idx] % mod;
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - t_idx, val);
                    }

                    base %= mod;
                    if (base < 0) base += mod;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); i++) {
                        long val = variables.get(i) % mod;
                        if (val < 0) val += mod;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    ans = ans.add(solve(variables, base, ans));
                }
            }
        }

        long[] prefixCount = new long[n_str.length() + 1];
        prefixCount[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n_str.length(); i++) {
            prefixCount[i + 1] = prefixCount[i] * 10 + (n_str.charAt(i) - '0');

        long cur = 0;

        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); len++) {
            curst.append(n_str.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1; // 1-based
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); pos++) {
                for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < curst.charAt(pos); dig++) {
                    val += count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, n_str);
                }
                tmp.append(curst.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= cur;
            val %= mod;
            if (val < 0) val += mod;
            totalAns += val;
        }

        totalAns %= 1000000007;
        System.out.println(toString(BigInteger.valueOf(totalAns)));
        sc.close();
    }

    static BigInteger toString(BigInteger num) {
        if (num.equals(BigInteger.ZERO))
            return BigInteger.ZERO;
        return new BigInteger(num.toString());
    }

        return BigInteger.ZERO;
    }

    static long count_with_prefix(String s, long n, String n_str) {
        long ans = 0;
        long s_val = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray()) {
            s_val = 10 * s_val + (ch - '0');
        }
        int len_s = s.length();
        int len_n_str = n_str.length();

        for (int len = len_s; len <= len_n_str; len++) {
